title: Topcoat is pushing the boundary of server applications with Rust
summary: Topcoat is a Rust web framework showcased on the official Tokio blog, designed to push the boundaries of server application development by combining Rust's memory safety guarantees with an ergonomic API for building high-performance async services.
problem_solved: Simplifies the development of performant and memory-safe server applications in Rust without sacrificing developer experience
why_valuable: Enables Rust developers to build production-grade server applications more easily while maintaining Rust's performance and safety benefits
